SELECT board_seq.NEXTVAL FROM DUAL
INSERT INTO board (board_id, user_id, board_name, board_info, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{boardId}, #{userId}, #{boardName}, #{boardInfo}, SYSDATE, SYSDATE)
mapper.select: SELECT b.board_id, b.board_name, b.updated_at, COUNT(sp.pin_id) AS pin_count FROM board b LEFT JOIN saved_pin sp ON b.board_id = sp.board_id WHERE b.user_id = #{userId} GROUP BY b.board_id, b.board_name, b.updated_at
SELECT p.image_url, p.title, sp.pin_id, p.link_url FROM saved_pin sp JOIN pin p ON sp.pin_id = p.pin_id WHERE sp.board_id = #{boardId}
